Refactored the plant side of the model to match the profile-driven animal structure. [Plant.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/Plant.java:7) now owns shared plant lifecycle behavior, [PlantProfile.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/PlantProfile.java:4) holds immutable plant metadata, and [Seaweed.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/Seaweed.java:9) is reduced to a static profile plus constructor. That removes the last major one-off species lifecycle from the codebase.

I also tightened the simulator metadata layer: [SpeciesCatalog.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/SpeciesCatalog.java:6) is now a static registry, and [Simulator.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R007_module_java/Simulator.java:60) consumes it directly instead of instantiating a catalog object. At this point, both animal and plant species are configured through immutable metadata objects rather than scattering behavior and constants across the simulator and entity classes.

Verified with `javac *.java`. No automated tests exist beyond compilation.
